title: Webshelf: Browser Grey, refined
question: Shelf fixed: your lockup is back exactly as you drew it, with the shelf only under the books. Extending it across the page changed your logo, which I shouldn't have done. The page divider is a browser-style grooved rule instead. Everything else is unchanged: white page, full-colour images, bevelled controls, a real dark mode. Previews show desktop results (light), phone homepage (dark) and phone results (dark).

options.label: Browser White
options.lineage: 1994 browser pages, whitened: bevelled controls on a plain white page
options.thesis: The web people know: a white page, underlined blue links, visited purple, Times-style type. The browser era shows only in the controls (sunken search field, raised buttons, grooved rules). Your lockup appears exactly as drawn; your mark is the favicon, and while results load the leaning blue book rocks once.
materials: sunken field and raised button bevels
options.viewport: Your lockup at top left beside a sunken search field and raised Search button, the header closed by a grooved rule. Results as a numbered list of underlined links with plain addresses, a strip of full-colour images when the search has them, the topic panel as a raised plate on the right. Homepage: your lockup large and centred, search below.
options.risk: Plain by design; its character rests on the bevels, the grooved rules and the type, so those must be crisp everywhere.

options.label: Browser White with toolbar
options.lineage: the same, with a pale grey toolbar band in the header
options.thesis: As Browser White, but the header sits on a pale grey band like a browser toolbar, closed by a grooved rule; the page below stays white.
options.viewport: A pale grey band holds your lockup, the sunken search field and Search, closed by a grooved rule. Everything below is the same white page with full-colour images.
options.risk: A touch more nostalgic than plain white; the grey band must stay pale so the page still reads as white.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What search engines ship, executed impeccably: white page, centred pill, blue links.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement every visitor expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
